folds: exact calendar boundaries from completed research_v2, five folds
hyperparameters: freeze each fold's v2 4h/24h baseline configuration; do not optimize on extension tests
evaluation_cohorts: common 4h candidates shared across all arms
uncertainty: paired 7-day block bootstrap, 1000 replicates; exploratory intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted
disclosure: Extension requested after both v2 datasets' test results were examined. This is retrospective exploratory sensitivity analysis, not a new untouched confirmation. No new raw events are created. GNN v2 results are preserved, not retrained in this controlled two-model extension.
